_comment: Hand corrections merged over scraped feats by build_packs.py, keyed by feat id. Each entry needs a 'why' so the next reader can tell a fix from an opinion.

alertness.why: The SRD prints Alertness's benefit text under a 'Prerequisite' label. The feat has no prerequisite; see https://spellbooksoftware.com/d20mrsd/featorder.html
alertness.benefit: The character gets a +2 bonus on all Listen checks and Spot checks.
